title: introduce-batch-groomer-cost-schematic-and-quant-granulator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: production teams need tenant-aware batch defaults, a compact cost "schematic" for quick unit-econ estimates, and safe per-tenant quantization candidates. This PR adds a Batch Groomer that ingests recent request traces and synthesizes compact batch-shape templates, a Cost Schematic exporter that emits tenant-level unit-econ sketches for fast simulations, and a Quant Granulator that produces candidate quant profiles ranked by expected token-cost delta and conservative quality impact. Design highlights: 1) streaming trace processor (low-CPU) to compute shape histograms and warmup signals; 2) batch-shape template format (JSON schema v1) designed for lightweight routing heuristics; 3) cost-schematic generator that produces a small summary used by the dry-run simulator and the Console visualizer; 4) quant-granulator service that hooks into model registry annotations and emits per-model-per-tenant quant candidates plus safety scores; 5) CLI tool redwood cost-sim --dry-run to simulate cost/latency/quality tradeoffs with synthetic replay. Safety: defaults are conservative, the quant candidates carry a "rollback_score" and are gated by the existing prefillsafety pipeline; the rollout plan is staging-only by default. Checklist: - [x] trace ingestion and histogrammer - [x] batch-shape template serializer and schema - [x] cost-schematic exporter API (/internal/cost-schematic) - [x] quant-granulator worker + registry hooks - [x] CLI dry-run simulator and unit tests - [x] e2e smoke with synthetic replay - [x] console telemetry wiring (unit-econ delta metric) Testing: unit tests for histogrammer, schema validation, and quant scoring; integration test that runs a 1k-request synthetic replay and validates cost delta within expected bounds (<8% variance). Rollout plan: merge to main, enable for internal tenants in staging, collect unit-econ telemetry for 48 hours, then gate opt-in for selective tenants. Related: ENG-2145 (tenant profiling), ENG-2201 (prefill safety gates). Links: design doc (internal) and small example profiles included in this change.

release_notes: Adds Batch Groomer for tenant batch-shape templates, Cost Schematic exporter for fast unit-econ sketches, Quant Granulator to propose conservative quantization candidates, and a cost-sim dry-run CLI. Default behavior is staging-only; opt-in required for experimental quant candidates.
